title: Plasmaware
description: A science fiction mod that adds plasma tech and a new dimension waiting to be explored
body:
**Plasmaware is a mod which adds new tools, weapons, and an outer-space dimension waiting to be explored, all originating from plasma!**

**This mod is undergoing a major overhaul, expect many bugs and incomplete features for the time being!**
 
## Getting Started
After having defeated the wither, crafting a nether star into 64 plasma will get you started on this modded journey. With this you can craft armor and tools slightly better than netherite, but more importantly, a subspace translocator: Your portal to brand new dimension!

## Features
- 1 dimension
- 9 biomes
- 4 structures
- 13 mobs + 1 miniboss
- dark matter and antimatter equipment
- particle accelerator
- rayguns and bazookas
- armor upgrades
- 5 new TNTs
- black holes and white holes
- decorative blocks and plants
- and more!

## Permissions
You're free to add this to modpacks or mod showcase videos with credit, but please do not repost the mod to other sites.

## Credits
